headline: Colonial Incursion in Mooring County as Central Sectors Flare
war_summary: Frontline reports over the past three hours reveal a sudden Colonial breakthrough into Mooring County, where the capture of The Wind Hills has breached previously secure Warden territory amidst a sharp upward spike in casualties and reinforcements. Stonecradle remains the theater's most volatile sector, sustaining intense pressure with over two thousand combined casualties in two hours as fighting sweeps across Buckler Sound and The Reach. In Linn of Mercy, active base exchanges at Lathair and Rotdust persist up to the hour, though direct casualty rates have cooled following earlier heavy engagements. Callahan's Passage continues to endure relentless attrition, logging more than seventeen hundred casualties in two hours as both sides commit fresh troops. Further east, Weathered Expanse has seen casualty rates accelerate once more along contested lines, while Stlican Shelf witnessed renewed clashes around Thornhold. Meanwhile, earlier hotspots in Farranac Coast and The Gutter have largely stabilized without further territorial transfers in recent hours.
